items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: after they got Lester Young in there and Eight-Ball and all the boys, and Reuben Lynch and all them boys... I didn't want to leave 'em.

ctx.x: Reuben Lynch. Then he said, 'You all want to get out?' We say, 'Yeah, sure. We got to get back to Dallas. We got to go home.' 'Just follow me.' We had some music stands made all out of steel, you know, like these schools use -- old-timey. He just got one of them, folded it up. 'Follow me.'
